title: Descent of a twist section to a homogeneous basic-open fraction
statement: Let A be an N-graded commutative ring with grading 𝒜, k an integer and f homogeneous of positive degree. Every section s of twist 𝒜 k [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] on D₊(f) is represented by an element z of degreeZeroFractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions] for the shifted grading A(k). At every homogeneous prime of D₊(f), the image of z in the ordinary prime localization equals the value of s. This includes negative k and nilpotent f.

proof.text:
express the section locally as a fraction of homogeneous elements with degree
 difference k. Refine its neighborhoods to homogeneous basic opens inside D₊(f).
The affine basic open D₊(f) is quasi-compact, so retain finitely many neighborhoods.
Clear denominators and the finitely many equality witnesses on their intersections.
The localization gluing argument gives one fraction with denominator a power of f;
all operations preserve degree difference k. Its numerator lies in degree k+n where
its denominator has degree n. Negative numerator degrees contribute only zero.
The images of this fraction at every homogeneous prime are the given section.
For nilpotent f the open and its localization are empty and zero respectively.

lean.statement: theorem twist_fraction_descent {A σ : Type v} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (k : ℤ) (f : A) (b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 b) (s : (twist 𝒜 k).val.obj (op (basicOpen 𝒜 f))) : ∃ z : LocalizedModule.Away f A, z ∈ degreeZeroFractions (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝒜 n : Set A)) (fun n : ℕ ↦ {y : A | if 0 ≤ k + n then y ∈ 𝒜 (k + n).toNat else y = 0}) (Submonoid.powers f) ∧ ∀ p : basicOpen 𝒜 f, IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f) (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl) (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A) (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2) z = (s.1 p).1
